meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成可验证的步骤,循环执行直到收尾。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常有需要持续推进的大目标,希望分解执行、随时掌握进度。
copy.tagline_en: Break big goals into verified steps and loop through them until completion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a big goal to pursue and need to split it into small, trackable steps.

howto.what: Claude 会把目标先登记成正式条目,再拆成很细的一步步;每完成一步都要在真实输出(终端、网页结果等)上留下证据,拿不出证据就不算完成。
howto.when: 当你说出「ulw-loop」「ulw」等关键词,或要求做带检查点的持久执行、证据驱动的工作时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这个目标先登记,再一步步执行并留下证据。
say.note: Claude 会先读流程并登记目标,不会跳过。

say.text: 按 ulw-loop 模式工作:拆细步骤、检查每步的真实输出,再进入下一步。
say.note: 每个成功标准都要有可观察证据,光测试通过不算完成。

say.text: 让 ulw-loop 处理这个交付,独立的小任务交给子代理并行跑。
say.note: 只有任务相互重叠且能提速时才组团队,否则后台并行。

howto.what_en: Claude starts each goal by registering it, then breaks the work into very small steps; before a step counts as done it must collect observable evidence from a real surface (terminal, HTTP, browser, etc.).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "ulw-loop" or "ulw", or ask for durable, checkpointed execution / evidence-led work.

say_en.text: Run this as a ulw-loop: register, execute, collect evidence per step.
say_en.note: Claude registers the goal first and doesn't skip that.

say_en.text: Use a ulw-loop here: break work into small steps and show evidence for each.
say_en.note: Each criterion needs observable evidence, not just tests.

say_en.text: Handle this delivery with ulw-loop and run independent subtasks in parallel.
